<?php
class Zero204 { public $value = 0; public function __construct() { $this->value = 7; return 99; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketBase204 { public $value = null; function __construct($saved, $ignored) { $this->value = $saved; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketDerived204 extends PacketBase204 {}
class Base204 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived204 extends Base204 {}
$owner = new Derived204; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(new Zero204, new PacketDerived204(8, 9)); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved[0]->value === 7 && $child->saved[1]->value === 8) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

class Zero204 { public $value = 0; public function __construct() { $this->value = 7; return 99; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketBase204 { public $value = null; function __construct($saved, $ignored) { $this->value = $saved; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketDerived204 extends PacketBase204 {}
class Base204 { public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } }
class Derived204 extends Base204 {}
$prefix = "REQUEST"; $request = $prefix . "-NEW"; $child = Derived204::MiSsInG(new PacketDerived204($request, 0)); echo $child->saved[0]->value === "REQUEST-NEW" ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
class Zero204 { public $value = 0; public function __construct() { $this->value = 7; return 99; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketBase204 { public $value = null; function __construct($saved, $ignored) { $this->value = $saved; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class PacketDerived204 extends PacketBase204 {}
class Base204 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived204 extends Base204 {}
$owner = new Derived204; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(first:new PacketDerived204(1.5, 0), later:new Zero204); unset($owner); echo ($child->saved["first"]->value === 1.5 && $child->saved["later"]->value === 7) ? "OK;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift204() { global $argument, $owner; $argument = new New204; $owner = null; echo "SHIFT;"; return null; }
class Old204 { public $value = 7; public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } }
class New204 { public $value = 99; public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Packet204 { public $saved = 0; public function __construct($saved, $ignored) { $this->saved = $saved->value; echo "CTOR;"; return 7; } public function __destruct() { echo "PACKET;"; } }
class Base204 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $argument; $argument = null; echo "HANDLER;"; return new class($arguments) { public function __construct(public array $saved) {} public function __destruct() { echo "CHILD;"; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
class Derived204 extends Base204 {}
$argument = new Old204; $owner = new Derived204; $child = $owner->MiSsInG(new Packet204($argument, shift204()), null); echo "RETURN;"; echo ($child->saved[0] instanceof Packet204 && $child->saved[0]->saved === 7) ? "HELD;" : "BAD;"; unset($child); echo "AFTER;";
